title: Dimension-dependent bound for convex sets
statement:
There exists a constant $C>0$ such that, for every natural number $n$ and every measurable convex set $A\subseteq\mathbb R^n$, the Gaussian surface area of $A$ is at most
\[C n^{1/4}.\]
